# Showing or hiding the sidebar or the inspector: the window gives the column
# its width, or takes it back, on its side — the terminal keeps its size and
# its place on the screen to the point, and its grid never changes (nothing
# reflows, its program never hears of it). With animations as in the app too.
wait:1.0
# A window appears as it is: AppKit's opening zoom made its text seem to change size.
expect-no-open-animation:go
# (The grid it starts with counts as one; from here on, none.)
expect-regrids:1
expect-resize-frames:1
expect-font:13
expect-unmoved:here
action:toggle_sidebar
expect-unmoved:here
expect-regrids:0
expect-resize-frames:0
action:toggle_sidebar
expect-unmoved:here
expect-regrids:0
expect-resize-frames:0
action:toggle_inspector
expect-unmoved:here
expect-regrids:0
expect-resize-frames:0
action:toggle_inspector
expect-unmoved:here
expect-regrids:0
expect-resize-frames:0
motion:on
action:toggle_sidebar
expect-unmoved:here
expect-regrids:0
expect-resize-frames:0
action:toggle_sidebar
expect-unmoved:here
expect-regrids:0
expect-resize-frames:0
# Twice in a moment, back where it was.
action-now:toggle_sidebar
wait:0.1
action-now:toggle_sidebar
wait:0.5
expect-unmoved:here
expect-regrids:0
expect-resize-frames:0
# And back into the terminal from the sidebar.
key:shift+tab
wait:0.5
expect-unmoved:here
expect-regrids:0
expect-resize-frames:0
expect-font:13
